resolves: docs/PLAN.md L5's restated gate — 'validation against the reference across a topology matrix, not implementation'.
method: Topology is imposed IN SOFTWARE by the consuming node's filter, which drops a named node's DIRECT frames while still accepting relayed copies of them. Directness is read from the header: a frame carries its originator's low byte in relay_node, so a copy carrying anyone else's byte came via a relay. Physical placement gives one topology, imprecisely, and not the same one tomorrow; a filter gives a matrix, reproducibly. Sound for protocol questions and UNSOUND for RF ones — the protocol cannot distinguish 'filtered' from 'out of range', which is exactly why contention, capture and duty-cycle results are NOT taken from this apparatus.

topologies.name: A — one hop, no filter
topologies.arrived: hop_limit 3 of hop_start 3, direct from the originator
topologies.decision: relay=1, relay_hop=2, window=143 slots, draw=120 -> 3360 ms
topologies.then: the same (from,id) arrived again at hop_limit 2, a peer's rebroadcast -> duplicate=1, relay=0, suppressed=DUPLICATE
topologies.outcome: a peer (low byte 0x28) rebroadcast it before our backoff expired, so the queued relay was CANCELLED and we transmitted nothing. Confirmed from the far side: no frame carrying our relay byte for that id was observed at any stock node.

topologies.name: B — two hops, originator filtered
topologies.arrived: the originator's DIRECT frame was dropped (relay_node = its own low byte); the copy taken carried hop_limit 2 of hop_start 3
topologies.decision: relay=1, relay_hop=1, window=135 slots, draw=32 -> 896 ms
topologies.outcome: relayed onward at hop_limit 1 and ACCEPTED by an unmodified stock node, which logged it with our relay byte.

validated: Hop-limit decrement at two depths: 3->2 and 2->1, each accepted by a stock decoder.
Duplicate suppression against genuine duplicate traffic, not a constructed pair.
Relay cancellation when another node transmits first, INCLUDING the negative: nothing went out afterwards.
Contention-window draws fall inside the computed window at both depths.
relay_node carries our own low byte on our rebroadcast, matching what the corpus shows a stock node doing.
not_validated: Hop-limit EXHAUSTION (suppressed=HOP_LIMIT). A hop_limit=0 frame never appeared: stock nodes stop relaying before emitting one, so producing it needs a longer chain than three nodes give.
DUTY_BUDGET refusal — needs sustained traffic well beyond this run.
Everything RF: contention bounds, capture, and duty cycle are NOT measurable on a filtered topology, by construction.
observability_fix: The relay log lines carried no packet id, so 'queued', 'cancelled' and 'sent' could not be attributed to a packet. A cancel followed by an unrelated send therefore read as a defect — the cancel path looked broken when it was two different frames, this bench also relaying foreign traffic. Ids were added before any conclusion was drawn.
